I replied to Ilse in her direct message: she told me on 14 October that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30, and she hasn't sent me a change since.

I took that from her own direct message with me. When I looked the preference up in gbrain under her name, nothing came back. The save on 14 October said it worked, so the private setting may be hiding it from lookups, but I haven't confirmed why. If we rely on gbrain to remember this kind of thing, it isn't working yet.

My summary to you from last time also landed in Ilse's direct message, so she can see it. It only repeats her own dock detail and talks about her as "Ilse," so nothing leaked to anyone else, but those summaries shouldn't be landing in members' messages.
